scope: Two-day three-path finite miniature on the SAME dynamics/reward/resource kernel; not the seven-day held-out benchmark.
limitations: Oracle can enumerate the finite prior but shares second actions across identical observable histories; no perfect-information realized future supplied.
This tractable miniature does not prove the seven-day model optimality or general MCTS superiority.
Training tabular Q uses seven-day returns and is not relabeled as optimized for this different two-day objective.
